grammar.summary: 本课学习表伪装的 as 结构与过去完成叙事。

points.title: as if 虚拟（动作伪装）
points.explanation: He went among the enemy as if he were one of them. as if + were 虚拟复现：历史轶事中的伪装叙事。

examples.en: He wandered among the enemy camps disguised as a minstrel.
examples.cn: 他扮成吟游诗人混入敌营。

points.title: 过去完成时表先时叙事
points.explanation: He had learned much before he attacked. 历史叙事的时序：先侦察后行动，had done 先于 did。

examples.en: Alfred the Great had disguised himself as a shepherd.
examples.cn: 阿尔弗雷德大帝曾把自己装扮成牧羊人。
